description: Single major mistake (bible: failure to communicate): plan B's boats and dry power, but the barrier is skipped and both pumps are trusted to hold the basin through the peak. At the peak their outlets are under the tide and the forecast shows each delivering about 84 %, while the sea pours over the three-cell sill far faster than they lift; the basin climbs towards sea level, nothing drains it afterwards, and the medical landing road is lost at the end.
